response.rationale: Both answers accurately express “counterfeit product.” “Barang palsu” is established Indonesian usage, while “barangan tiruan” is well-supported Malaysian Malay usage. The forms are not false friends. “Different-common-word” is acceptable as a preference-level relation, though not an absolute exclusivity claim.
